selection: 33<=lat<39, -110<=lon<-103; archive count>=25; closest station to each 1-degree cell centre, station-code tie break
waveforms: EARS radial iterative RF, gaussian=2.5, archive match>=80
processing: resample to 5 Hz; arrival time b-a; normalize by interpolated t=0 radial amplitude (>0.05); p in [0.04,0.085]; 3 equal-count p bins
split: sort event filename within each p bin; every fourth event held out; at least 6 training and 2 test events/bin
likelihood: fit 0.8 to 26 s inclusive; empirical training-mean covariance shrunk 25% toward diagonal, plus fixed 0.03-amplitude Gaussian-correlated discrepancy (0.5 s scale) and 0.005 diagonal floor
